title: Caveat
text:
When life tears my soul a gapin' hole,
I often put pen to paper.

And what I write, a horrendous sight,
seems to be romantic garbage.

Yet if you look beyond the love-sick song,
there is plenty of hidden meaning.

So if you read my work, don't go berserk,
and laugh or cry exceedingly.

title: Gift Life
text:
I knew my life was good,
but I wanted to know I earned it,
so I went to school to learn it,
took a job to work it,
found some books to read it,
gave it away to receive it,
married in order to love it,
lost it.

Until...

I fell
naked
into it.

title: Field Theory
text:
Energy
surrounds me
then confounds me.

Closest as I wake
in that lucid state;
my dreams bring past into present
untangling my reality.

This energy of being,
more elusive through effort,
fills me with light,
creates the words on this page
as I dissolve into awe.

title: Belonging
text:
In the case of your belonging gone wrong,
try again,
and then again,
until you find some measure of belonging or collapse,
into that greater belonging
that was yours all along.

title: Take a Moment
text:
Take a moment,
but don't think too long.
The time is ripe
for you to lend
your gifts
to the very circular struggle
called being.
What else would you do
with your one precious life?

title: Divine Poet
text:
A poem may save a life,
but only after it has rescued you
from a certain death.
Do not despair if you cannot hear
the verses whispered by the wind,
nor see the way the light illuminates
all the poems crawling on the ground.
If only a second remains,
there is enough time,
within your lifetime,
to be overcome
by the playful poet called God.

title: The Way of Council
text:
The man next to me
is edgy and raw.
His years,
his failed marriages,
his burning anger,
have all had a blunting effect
on the once razor-sharp blade
of his being.
I too have this edge,
mine also made ragged by failure.
And so the sparks begin to fly
as we sit down together.
Our energy is hot and thick,
and archetypal warrior.
We needn't say a word
to start a silent battle.
There's something in our being
which has often lead to war.
So we sit in an uneasy silence.
Other men now join the circle.
Together we hold this tension
and create a sacred space.
The heart stone passes between us
as words unravel our twisted tongues.
We listen without judgment.
When the day is finally over,
a fraternal bond has developed
and we embrace.

title: Truth
subtitle: Behold her smile!
text:
God
has many offspring.
One of them is Truth,
and she accompanies us
on our lifelong journeys,
steady and assured,
never fazed
by our defiance
to her exacting demands,
while we begrudgingly
follow her towards the light.

title: It's in the Stillness
subtitle: ...all the pieces come together.
text:
Gather with you to the stillness
as much as you can carry.
Then allow it to spill over
into that abyss called forgetting.
The next morning you will awaken
with a reaffirmed sense of knowing,
but newly aware anything not pointing
to the absolute uncertainty called God
is no longer worth holding onto.

title: Haiku 2
text:
Every breath you take
is a greeting at the door
of Rumi's guest house.

title: In the Mirror
text:
Once again, I've come to a doorway.
Behind it lies another mystery.
Prominently fixed in the center,
is a large brass knocker forged
in the shape of a question mark.
There's no need for me to knock.
The door is always unlocked.
I must only summon the courage
to turn the tarnished knob and enter.
On the pathway through life
inevitability manages my load,
but it is gratitude and surrender
nudging me ever-forward on my journey.
I still pause on the threshold,
think twice before stepping out.
Then I glance in the mirror and wonder,
will this be the last time I see
the person looking back at me?
